notes: Collected from the same public data queries used by the live site, with exact row counts checked for each gallery collection.
Livestreams and station queue include active entries only, matching the public site.
Repeated YouTube IDs are stored once; placements preserve each source record, category, featured flag, and available ordering metadata.
Titles and descriptions are included only when stored by the site; null means the source did not provide a value.
Video files, photographs, GIFs, channel-only links, and private administrator content are excluded.
Links were exported as stored by the site. YouTube availability, playback, and embedding permissions were not individually checked.
